name: Decoupled Entity Notifications
description: Provides the ability to subscribe and receive updates when entities are updated.
project_description: Decoupled Entity Notifications (DEN) lets visitors of a decoupled/headless front-end subscribe by email to changes on specific Drupal entities and receive notifications when those entities are updated or archived. Content editors enable subscribing per entity through a bundled 'notification_settings' field; a JSON API (subscribe, confirm, unsubscribe, unsubscribe-all, request overview) drives a double opt-in flow secured by signed JWT tokens. Notification delivery is pluggable via a 'notification_type' plugin type, with a bundled Symfony Mailer submodule (DENSM) providing email delivery. Requires Dynamic Entity Reference.
